author: Ifmyante
text:
Hi Nasir

We're in the very fortunate position of knowing exactly what to look for in our traders, and knowing how to handle them.

We train all our traders to make sure they know exactly how the market works, and how to handle themselves in it.

No trader, no matter what his track history, gets to trade investors'
money straight away. They'll get a small fund of RTM capital to start
with, and constant support (there'll be support through all stages, of
course).

If they manage to lose 15% of this account, they'll be benched.

If they thrive, they'll be introduced to a small portion of the fund; no more than they've ever handled well personally.

They'll have 15% leeway on this too.

Should they thrive, that account will be doubled, and doubled again once ready, etc.

For the sake of our investors, our focus will be on preparing and
maintaining the most confident and most profitable traders imaginable.

This will keep the stress on everybody to the absolute minimum :)

Edit: That didn't answer your question!

The traders will not be taking any personal financial risk, so long as
they stick to their trading plans. Mistakes will not be punished, but
reckless trading or attempts at sabotage would certainly see them facing
 action.
